items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: The piano player was Tony Jackson. You've probably heard of him, Tony Jackson?

ctx.x:
And we finally knew -- I finally knew that the clarinet player was Sidney Bechet. We say Bechet, but in France they say 'Bechette'.

The piano player was Tony Jackson.

You've probably heard of him, Tony Jackson?
